note: Structured state for known gaps/exclusions — not prose. Each entry has an id, area, reason, the commit/date it was introduced, and a removal condition so it blocks regression and measures progress instead of just describing. See docs/test-suite.md for the suite and CRITICS.md for the review these track.

entries.reason: QUiLoader-only private Qt widgets (QFileDialog internals, QtGradient editors, qprintpropertieswidget) are not public API, so the differential oracle can't hold them.
entries.excludes: a subset of tests/uic/corpus/*.ui from corpus-check
entries.remove_when: never (these are not public Qt API)

entries.reason: An overridden virtual that returns a container/QList still dispatches non-virtually — the C++ method shim can't sret those, so it falls back to the direct-symbol guard.
entries.impact: no known Qt override is affected

entries.reason: A method with a move-only (deleted-copy) by-value param uses the direct pragma decl, or is dropped if inline — the shim/guard would copy the param.
entries.remove_when: the shim forwards value params by std::move

entries.reason: Linux/POSIX is Tier 1; Windows/MSVC-x64 is a documented roadmap (docs/windows-roadmap.md), not tested.
entries.remove_when: the windows-roadmap tiers are implemented and green

entries.reason: qmlRegisterType fills QQmlPrivate::RegisterType and calls QQmlPrivate::qmlregister — a private struct whose layout (structVersion, CreationMethod) can shift between Qt minor versions. No public API registers a runtime QMetaObject as a QML type.
entries.probe: qmlreg-{ldc2,dmd} compile+link against QQmlPrivate; they FAIL to build if the struct/symbol changes — that IS the per-version guard.
entries.remove_when: Qt exposes a public API to register a runtime metaobject as a QML type, or the probe is extended across a Qt version matrix in CI

entries.reason: .qmltypes validation uses QQmlJSTypeDescriptionReader from Qt6QmlCompiler private API (the same reader qmllint/qmltyperegistrar use). Private; can change across versions.
entries.probe: qmltypes-{ldc2,dmd} compile the validator against it and skip cleanly if Qt6QmlCompiler is absent; a signature change breaks the build.
entries.remove_when: a public qmltypes parser ships, or the probe runs across a Qt version matrix

entries.reason: The runtime moc (qtdmoc.cpp) builds QMetaObjects with QMetaObjectBuilder, a Qt private API. Long-standing dependency (documented in README); listed here so it is tracked as structured risk, not just prose.
entries.probe: every moc/qml/tr target compiles qtdmoc.cpp against it; exercised on the Qt versions in the matrix (6.11, and 5.15 via the wrap specs).
entries.remove_when: never expected (no public equivalent); revisit if Qt ships a public runtime-metaobject builder
